content: Upstream requirements: RS_ARTIFO_00014, SRS_Os_12002 The OS shall incorporate special macros that can be used by an ARTI trace tool to insert tracing functionality of any kind. These macros shall be active only if the Boolean configuration parameter OsUseArti is set to true, thereby enabling tracing support globally within the OS.
